name: hs-hold
note: THE 250-400 m/s HOLE IN THE CORPUS, AND THE ONE DEFECT THAT LIVES IN IT. captures.db (3027 captures) has ZERO rows between 250 and 400 m/s and every airframe tops out at 221 m/s, because every card enters at ~1.0x corner and nothing accelerates. debugtests/DISCORD-V68-TRIAGE.md section 2 is a field report from exactly the missing band: an FS-12 at 348-400 m/s limit-cycling the ROLL axis at ~2 Hz WHILE ON TARGET - targetBank -0.16 deg mean, off 0.19 deg, elevErr sd 0.03 deg, and outR swinging -0.53..+0.62 with rollRate +-0.77 and Rflip 105 in 29.6 s. The outer loop is commanding nothing and the inner roll servo is oscillating on its own: RollDamping x rollRateF overwhelming a still-live P-error and inverting the stick (t=223.500 bank -6.8 vs target 0.0 -> outR +0.509; 0.18 s later the error is still +5.1 the same direction and outR is -0.230). That is GENERALITY-REVIEW.md finding 5 (RollGain/RollDamping/RollRateSmoothing are global constants, unnormalized by q) plus its internal twin, 1.28 Hz on Multirole1 at ~450 m/s (rec 014141). This card exists to put that state on the schedule instead of waiting for another Discord post. NAMING TRAP: FS-12 IS 'Fighter1'. 'SmallFighter1' is the FS-20 Vortex - see AIRFRAMES.md. GEOMETRY IS THE FIELD REPORT'S OWN PROTOCOL: level, no elevation demand at all, a small azimuth offset held for 30 s, i.e. settled on-boresight cruise - NOT a maneuver. The 2 deg mirrored steps into fineHS1R/L are the transient; the measurement is the settled tail of each 30 s hold, where azErr is ~0 and the law should be commanding nothing. fineHS05R/L add a mirrored 0.5 deg pair, inside the v0.65 settle cone, to catch the entry transient at the scale the field report actually sat at. ENTRY IS 2.2x THE FBW CORNER, AND 2.2 IS NOT A ROUND NUMBER: it is the largest multiple every lane clears at the v0.92 envelope gate. 0.95 x Vmax / FBW corner is 2.28 for FastBomber1 (the binding lane), 2.38 Fighter1, 2.47 Multirole1, 2.55 SmallFighter1, so 2.3 already refuses a lane pre-spawn. 2.2 places 352 / 352 / 341 / 440 m/s - the band the corpus has never seen, bracketing the field report's 348-423. THE ROSTER IS NOT A CHOICE, IT IS THE SET THAT CLEARS: of the ten fixed-wing keys, 2.2x refuses trainer (286 vs 279.7), VTOLTrainer1 (352 vs 279.7), CAS1 (352 vs 195.3), COIN (242 vs 134.6) and EW1 (286 vs 271.8) at the gate. Darkreach is the one key left out by hand - it clears (220 vs 265.2) but 2.2 x its 100 corner does not reach the band this card exists to fill, so it would spend a lane measuring 220 m/s again. WHY THIS ENTRY IS HOLDABLE AND stol-sweep's WAS NOT, which is the whole design: R39-stol measured these same jets running to 340-381 m/s on a pinned 1.00 throttle at 2500-6000 m, i.e. full throttle TRIMS them right here. The stol cards had to fight that (declared 90, flew 381); this card asks for the speed the pin already holds, so the placement and the trim agree instead of racing. ScenarioThrottle is pinned at 1.00 for that reason and must not be lowered - at 0.70 the entry becomes a deceleration and the card slides back out of the band. Nothing HOLDS the speed either way (AuditHold is instrument, not controller), so grep 'ENTRY CONDITION NOT HELD' before scoring, and read spd on the first capture: anything still above ~300 m/s at the end of fineHS1L is in band. NO VERTICAL DEMAND ANYWHERE, so 90 s at 4000 m cannot reach the 500 m FloorAltM abort - unlike every other high-energy card in the grid, this one has no altitude budget to blow. THE ALTITUDE-DECK FACTOR DOES NOT EXIST - this note used to claim 'DroneAltDeckM can be LEFT AT ITS 3000 DEFAULT, the decks put half the fleet at 2500 m and half at 5500 m, q 59.5 vs 43.5 kPa, crossed with airframe on the Latin-square diagonal'. R43 measured all 12 valid captures at 4000 m (descending to ~3570), one value of entry_alt_to for the whole card. The deck sets the drone's SPAWN altitude; placement then teleports every lane to startAlt, so the 2500/5500 spread survives only as entry_alt_from - where the drone loitered before it was placed. See LAW-LEDGER.md X32. The pin stays at 3000 for continuity with R43, but it buys nothing here; q's only lever on this card is speed. PASS = outR sd under ~0.05 over the settled tail with no sustained sign flipping: wobbleFreqHzOutR ABSENT (osc_mode found no supportable mode), wobbleEpisodesOutR 0, stickFlipRateR at the oblique family's level, and the R/L mirror pairs within noise of each other. FAIL = the R6-02 signature: wobbleFreqHzOutR 1-2 Hz with wobbleCoherenceOutR high, wobbleEpisodesOutR > 0 at pp 0.3+, stickFlipRateR several per second, all of it while targetBank is ~0 and off is under 1 deg. Read targetBank/tBankE beside it - a limit cycle WITH a live bank demand is a different (outer-loop) defect and belongs to the oblique family, not here. FLOWN R43 (v1.0.3, 2026-08-02) - VALID, AND THE ANSWER IS NO. 12 valid captures (Fighter1 / Multirole1 / SmallFighter1, 4 replicates each); FastBomber1 was lost on 3 of 3 placements ('abort: aircraft gone', 1 sample, dur=0.0) and its lane was retired. Over 48 settled tails at 407-505 m/s and q 71.6-112.3 kPa - four to five times the corpus's previous peak of 25.6 kPa - the PASS criteria above are met with three orders of margin: outR sd 0.0007-0.0045 against the ~0.05 threshold, peak-to-peak 0.004-0.025 against the field report's ~1.15, rollRate sd 0.003-0.021 deg/s against +-0.77, stickFlipRateR 0.033-0.084/s against 3.55/s and at or BELOW the oblique family's own 0.055 mean, wobbleEpisodesOutR 0 on 48/48, and wobbleFreqHzOutR resolving on only 5 of 48 - each at coherence 0.23-0.35, i.e. a frequency estimate on a 0.002-amplitude signal, never the high-coherence fail shape. The outer loop was as quiet as the card requires (targetBank identically 0.000, |tBankE| mean 0.09-0.56 deg, off 0.01-0.06 deg), so the tails ARE the state the field report describes - the servo simply does not oscillate there. LAW-LEDGER.md O11 stays OPEN on the one condition a card cannot script: a human on the mouse. THREE CORRECTIONS FOR ANYONE RE-FLYING IT. (1) IT DOES NOT HOLD SPEED, IT ACCELERATES. Entry placed 352/352/341 m/s as designed and then full throttle with no vertical demand ran the lanes to 428 / 506 / 438 m/s by 90 s. Nothing decelerated, so no lane left the band and the hole is filled - but the card also spans 400-506, which was NOT the design, and 'hold' is the wrong word. The R39-stol reasoning that full throttle 'trims them right here' was measured at 2500-6000 m; at 4000 m with zero elevation demand it trims 76-154 m/s higher. (2) q IS CONFOUNDED WITH AIRFRAME. With FastBomber1 gone and the deck a no-op, each surviving key contributes exactly one q band (71.6-81.5 / 87.6-112.3 / 72.3-84.9 kPa). Only WITHIN-airframe q trends are defensible - and those are real: Spearman(q, outR sd) = +0.891 on Multirole1 (sd 0.0012 -> 0.0045 over 87.6 -> 112.3 kPa), +0.638 Fighter1, +0.141 SmallFighter1. The unnormalized derivative gain of GENERALITY-REVIEW.md finding 5 IS visible, at ~1/1000 of limit-cycle amplitude. (3) USE THE 0.5 deg PAIR FOR THE R/L MIRROR CHECK, NOT THE 1 deg PAIR. fineHS1L scores 25-47% worse than fineHS1R on rmsPointingErrorDeg and fixedWindowOffDeg on 12/12 captures, but it always flies later and therefore faster; the adjacent fineHS05R/L pair is q-matched to within 5 m/s and shows NO asymmetry (L equal or 4-9% better). The 1 deg gap is the speed ramp, not handedness. CARD-OWNED VALUES (v1.0.3): Drone/DroneAltDeckM = 3000 - corpus: R43 flew this value and every lane still flew 4000 m (the card's own startAlt), because the deck is a SPAWN altitude and placement overrides it - LAW-LEDGER.md X32. Kept at 3000 for continuity with R43; 0 would fly identically.
